title: Emily / Taryn - Operator: Supported Markets

items.topic: Supported markets moved to Operator Details
items.statement: Taryn built a proof of concept on the Operator page. Supported Markets was moved from the highlights panel in Joyce's prototype to the Operator Details section; the reason given was that one operator had 12 or 13 supported markets, which would clutter the header.
items.quote: Taryn Reithofer: Okay. So we had pulled the supported markets from the initial prototype that Joyce made that was in the eyelids panel up here and now it lives under um operator details. / Taryn Reithofer: Mhm. Yeah. I think we the idea was that we brought it down into details because there was a I think there was a particular operator who had like 12 or 13 supported markdowns which would clutter the header up here.
items.asr_note: eyelids panel = highlights panel [ASR?]; markdowns = markets [ASR?]

items.topic: Supported markets set at onset, evolve via deals
items.statement: Supported markets must be set when the operator is created and then change through deal creation. Users would not update the field directly on the operator page; values come from deal creation.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: This would be have to have the ability to be created at onset and then evolve with through deal creation. / Emily Vandenberg: Right? So, you know, the example of like we bring Bet MGM on through ... but you wouldn't be necessarily going and updating it directly here like it'd be pulled in from your deal creation
items.critic_note: Firmness kept (client statement). Note tension: later in the call (line 188) Emily says nothing in Joyce's prototype shows setting the market at operator creation, and the field should be a roll-up from deals (see item -06). Line 165 'set and forget' supports the onset point. Quote uses '...' to elide part of line 133; wording otherwise verbatim.

items.topic: Frequency of new operator creation
items.statement: New operators are added rarely. In September a new operator in the prediction market space was first brought in under the partner Kina (since paused) and then under another partner. With new markets ahead, Emily said new operators could happen, but monthly 'might be extreme'.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: A couple of them in the prediction market space. They were originally brought in under the partner of Kina, which we've since paused and now brought that um brought that operator on in another partner situation. / Emily Vandenberg: But like given that there's some new markets um that we're kind of diving into um I would say yeah it could happen / Emily Vandenberg: Yeah. Monthly might be like um extreme but there will be cases for it that that could happen.

items.topic: Supported markets multi-select has 70 values
items.statement: The Supported Markets field is built as a multi-select picklist. It would have about 70 values in alphabetical order, with no search; users would scroll and move values over.
items.quote: Taryn Reithofer: Mhm. Okay. So, right now this is set up as a multiquis obviously. / Taryn Reithofer: Um, and when it like upon creation, this list would actually be uh 70 lines long, I believe. Yeah, 70 lines. / but there wouldn't be like an option to like search or anything. It would just be purely scrolling and finding it and then moving it over.

items.topic: Dependent country-then-market selection
items.statement: Emily asked if the selection could be dependent (pick Canada or the US, then get the next drop-down). Taryn said she would have to ask the team and assumed it would be a bigger build than a plain picklist.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: And there's not like an in between where you're like picking Canada and then it gives you your drop down. And it like gives you your next selection or picking the US and then it giving you. / Taryn Reithofer: I I I would have to take that back and ask the team, but it would be a I would assume that would be a bigger build than just doing a pick list like this.

items.topic: Supported markets is a roll-up from deals
items.statement: Emily confirmed, using Joyce's prototype, that Supported Markets on the operator is a roll-up from deals and is not set manually at operator creation; the office will update the deal, not the operator. Taryn agreed it makes sense and will take it back to the team (build approach not yet confirmed by the Jumpr team).
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: Supported markets as like a rollup, but then um there wasn't any place here, right, where she was like doing a selection. Yeah. / Emily Vandenberg: but it would still just be a roll up. / Taryn Reithofer: Yes. / Emily Vandenberg: Okay. So, yeah, there's nothing in here that shows like at the operator creation that you would be setting the market / Taryn Reithofer: Okay. Roll it from the deals. Okay, cool. I think that makes sense. I'll take that back to the team.

items.topic: Is supported markets roll-up needed in Phase 1
items.statement: Emily said she did not think this was originally scoped for the operator and asked whether the roll-up is needed for Phase 1 if it is a big lift. Taryn said it could be pushed to a later phase if more build time is needed. No deferral was decided.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: I don't we I don't think we scoped this as original um for the operator but if this is coming out of the like rollup I'm I'm like wondering if this is if the question is do we even need that roll up for phase Fun. / if if we want to take the time to make it more user friendly and have more substance, then I assume it would we could push it to the to the later phase. / if that's like a big lift then we probably should talk about if we need it for phase one.

items.topic: Check earlier transcript on supported markets
items.statement: Taryn offered to go back to the earlier (August) mockup review transcript to see exactly what was said about supported markets.
items.quote: I believe the first time we ever spoke about it was like the beginning of or the end of August or beginning of August when we first went through the mockups Joyce had made and we probably like breezed breeze past it and didn't talk about it in detail, but I can go back to the transcript and see exactly what was said.

items.topic: Raise roll-up complexity; ask Joyce on Phase 1
items.statement: Taryn will take the roll-up approach back to the team. If it becomes complicated, Taryn will raise it, and then they will ask Joyce whether it is needed for Phase 1.
items.quote: Taryn Reithofer: Okay. Roll it from the deals. Okay, cool. I think that makes sense. I'll take that back to the team. / Emily Vandenberg: and if this becomes complicated just like please just raise and then we can ask Joyce the question around if it's needed for phase one

items.topic: Associated operators counts active only; rename
items.statement: The Associated Operators field (roll-up from the Operator and Partner Relationship junction) will count only operators with active deals with the partner, and the field title will be Active Operators.
items.quote: Do you want it to be operators with active deals with the partner or all operators that have ever had a deal with the partner? / Emily Vandenberg: I would just do active but then like put active operators. / Taryn Reithofer: Yeah, I like changed the field title. / Emily Vandenberg: Mhm.
items.asr_note: 'I like changed the field title' may be 'I'd like to change the field title' [ASR?]

items.topic: No help text on highlight panel fields
items.statement: Taryn checked and help text cannot be added to highlight panel fields, which is one reason to make the field title clear.
items.quote: Um, and I and I checked we aren't able to um add help test text to um any highlight panel fields here

items.topic: Rename field to Active Operators
items.statement: Taryn will change the Associated Operators field title to Active Operators.
items.quote: Taryn Reithofer: So, change the title

items.topic: BA players related list cannot be renamed or searched
items.statement: The earlier ask was for the players related list on the Brand Ambassador page to be searchable and renamed. Because it is on the standard User object, Taryn cannot do either.
items.quote: I think the the discussion was we weren't you would like for the list to be searchable and also um the title changed. / Taryn Reithofer: Um but unfortunately because it's the standard user object I looked into it I can't do either. / Taryn Reithofer: So like I it Can't rename this to be player related list and I can't have a search feature in this list either.

items.topic: Remove players related list from BA page
items.statement: Emily decided to remove (hide) the players related list from the Brand Ambassador page. BAs have full access and can find players other ways, such as the All Players list.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: Let me confirm, but my gut tells me just like hide it. Like just don't do we just don't need it. It's like they can search. / Emily Vandenberg: they have full access. / Emily Vandenberg: They can search through many different ways. They can go to their all players list / Emily Vandenberg: Just remove just Yeah, I'm making the decision. Just we don't need it.
items.supersedes_hint: Earlier ask was to keep the list but make it searchable and renamed; now the list is removed.

items.topic: Deals removed from sign-up header panel
items.statement: Taryn removed Deals from the sign-up header panel, but the completion field is still on the second line.
items.quote: Um so I did I took out deals, / Taryn Reithofer: but the completion is still on that second line.

items.topic: Check market/state automations before combining
items.statement: Taryn will check the back end to see if the market or state fields drive anything else or any automations. If not, she can make one field that combines the two so the header fits on one line.
items.quote: So I'll I'll have to go into the back end and see if the um market or state is being used to um blow in anything else or any automations in the back end. If not, then I can make a field combining the two and I'm sure that'll make it one line.

items.topic: Combine proof and completion percent fields
items.statement: Emily suggested combining the proof and completion percentage fields as another option, and said these two areas (proof/completion and market/state) could be combined.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: or like also if you the proof and completions like percent you could combine those like / Emily Vandenberg: So I think I think those two areas have like combined.

items.topic: Header field sizes and padding not adjustable
items.statement: Field sizes in the header cannot be changed much; there is padding between fields and Taryn does not think there is an easy UI workaround.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: I'm assuming your field sizes you can't play around with too much. / Taryn Reithofer: No, unfortunately there's a I know there's a lot of like padding in between each each one. / but I don't I I don't think that would be an easy work around in terms of the UI.

items.topic: Report back on sign-up header field options
items.statement: Taryn will look into both header scenarios and come back to Emily with a result.
items.quote: Um, yeah, I'll look into both those scenarios and see if there's anything that I can change with those fields and I'll / Taryn Reithofer: I'll come back to you with a a result.

Taryn first understood it as WagerTech providing the data and said Kobe and Cedric handle this area. No commitment was made in the meeting.
items.quote: do you feel like we're ready for you guys to provide templates of like data importing for like some of the key objects that we've like nailed down like sign up um referral secondary referral player kind of thing / Taryn Reithofer: Kobe and Cedric have been mainly taking care of that bit. So I don't I don't know 100%. / Emily Vandenberg: Yeah. No, no. I was just like, do you guys want to like give us the template in which like you know what I mean?

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Discussed evaluating whether the multiselect market field is necessary for phase 1 due to complexity.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Emily Vandenberg: I don't we I don't think we scoped this as original um for the operator but if this is coming out of the like rollup I'm I'm like wondering if this is if the question is do we even need that roll up for phase Fun.
gemini_disagreements.why: Minor: transcript questions whether the supported-markets roll-up is needed for Phase 1, not the multi-select field itself; it is an open question, not an evaluation underway.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Emily requested data import templates for sign up and referral objects to scope timelines.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Taryn Reithofer: Yeah. Um I would say if you have it then yes because then it would be easier for us to scope out the timeline if we have all the information. / Emily Vandenberg: Yeah. No, no. I was just like, do you guys want to like give us the template in which like you know what I mean?
gemini_disagreements.why: Misattributed rationale: 'scope timelines' was Taryn's remark while misunderstanding the ask; Emily's stated reason was to clean up data into an ingestible form (line 263-270).

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Emily Vandenberg decided that the field should only count active deals and instructed Taryn Reithofer to change the field title to active operators to reduce confusion, noting that help text cannot be added to highlight panel fields.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Um, and I and I checked we aren't able to um add help test text to um any highlight panel fields here
gemini_disagreements.why: Minor misattribution: the help text limitation was stated by Taryn, not Emily.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Emily Vandenberg suggested combining the proof and completion percentage fields or combining the market and state fields to consolidate their layout into a single line. Taryn Reithofer committed to investigating back-end automations to see if market or state fields are tied to other functions, after which they will implement a combined field and report back to Emily Vandenberg with the results.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: If not, then I can make a field combining the two and I'm sure that'll make it one line. / Emily Vandenberg: or like also if you the proof and completions like percent you could combine those like
gemini_disagreements.why: Misattributed and firmer: combining market and state was Taryn's idea, Emily added proof/completion. The combined field is conditional on no automation dependency ('If not, then I can'), not a commitment to implement.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: [Emily Vandenberg] Review Referrals: Review the referral page feedback provided by Taryn to ensure it meets requirements and report back.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Taryn Reithofer: Oh, uh, one other thing. I don't believe we got actually any feedback from our referral page from you. / Emily Vandenberg: So, I'll do that today.
gemini_disagreements.why: Inverted (critic): Taryn provided the referral record page; Emily owes the feedback. There is no 'feedback provided by Taryn' to review.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Taryn Reithofer agreed to consult the team on pick list options
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Taryn Reithofer: I I I would have to take that back and ask the team, but it would be a I would assume that would be a bigger build than just doing a pick list like this.
gemini_disagreements.why: Minor, firmer (critic): Taryn said she 'would have to' ask the team about a dependent country-then-market selection and expected a bigger build; not an explicit agreement to consult on pick list options.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: System limitations prevent list renaming and search features. Related list removed and hidden entirely.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Emily Vandenberg: Just remove just Yeah, I'm making the decision. Just we don't need it.
gemini_disagreements.why: Minor (critic): the transcript shows a decision to remove the list, not that removal is complete; no owner was explicitly assigned in the transcript (Gemini Next steps assigns it to Taryn).

notes: 24-minute 1:1 working session (Jumpr: Taryn; WagerTech: Emily). Topics: Operator page supported markets (roll-up from deals; Phase 1 need open, to raise with Joyce if complex), Associated Operators -> Active Operators, BA players related list removed, sign-up header layout, data import templates (Emily to ping Kobe), Kobe design-flow review Wednesday (conditional), referral page feedback pending from Emily.
